newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields: 6-,12-mo down, 3-,9-mo same.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields: 6-,12-mo down, 3-,9-mo same.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three- and nine-month treasury bills stayed the same while yields on six- and 12-month T-bills slipped from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Friday.

Three-month bills remained at 24.47 percent, six-month bills slipped to 31.14 percent from 31.30 percent, nine-month bills remained at 34.86 percent, and 12-month bills eased to 39.79 percent from 39.93 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 5.00 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Amount sold 3.55 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.35 million UAH 4.71 million UAH
The central bank sold 35,525 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 11.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 8.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 4.11 million UAH 63.64 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.56 million UAH 55.05 million UAH
The central bank sold 41,100 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 11.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20.00 million UAH 30.00 million UAH
Amount sold 1.69 million UAH 29.07 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.34 million UAH 23.05 million UAH
The central bank sold 16,888 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 11.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 25.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 18.66 million UAH 95.67 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.36 million UAH 68.42 million UAH
The central bank sold 186,627 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 11.
